name: manual_9e83ac
claim: Pair every substantive GossipBus agent_note with an agent_pulse from the same agent ID: coordination monitors treat unpulsed agents as dormant or crashed, causing accidental task takeovers.

decisions.notes: Agent coordination heartbeat monitors check pulse timestamps. Emitting an agent_note without a matching agent_pulse triggers liveness warnings and risks spurious task takeovers across distributed Mac and Windows hosts.

rationale: Agent coordination heartbeat monitors check pulse timestamps. Emitting an agent_note without a matching agent_pulse triggers liveness warnings and risks spurious task takeovers across distributed Mac and Windows hosts.
